Added the per-field lockability seam to apps/web/src/routes/panel/provider/-announcement-form.tsx. New exports AnnouncementFieldKey (id|location|category|title|subtitle|description|price|tags|contact|cta|image|verifiedBadge), AnnouncementFieldPolicy ({editable:boolean}), AnnouncementFieldPolicyMap, and resolveAnnouncementFieldPolicy(mode) whose default map locks identity (id) and keeps every other field incl. category editable for create+edit (MVP). AnnouncementForm gained an optional fieldPolicy prop; resolves policy = fieldPolicy ?? resolveAnnouncementFieldPolicy(mode). Wired disabled={!policy.<field>.editable} on native controls (location Select, title/subtitle Input, description Textarea, image upload+change buttons, verified Checkbox combined with !canVerify). Composed sections (category/price/tags/contact/cta) carry policy entries but are not disabled-wired (no disabled prop; out-of-scope to change them) — freezing one later adds a single disabled prop to that one component. Default policy = all editable except non-rendered id so create behavior is unchanged. ST-03 (create-route migration/parity) already satisfied by ST-01 thin wrapper.
